paper_title: CAPSTONE Curriculum Sampling for Dense Retrieval with Document   Expansion
caption: Results of DPR with corpus, document, and asymmetric expansion on the dev set of MS-Marco.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) at a cutoff of 10, with respect to the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis represents the "Number of queries used during inference (S).", using a linear scale ranging from 2 to 10, marked at intervals of 2. The y-axis shows "MRR@10", also on a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains four lines. The first line is "DPR w/o query" with black, solid, without markers, depicting a constant value of approximately 34.3 across the entire x-axis. The second line is "DPR w/ corpus expansion", red, with circle markers and a solid style, beginning at an approximate value of 35.1 and slightly increasing to a value of around 35.8 by the x-axis end. The third line is green, with triangle markers and a solid line, starting at about 34.8 and fluctuating slightly, ending at around 34.8 at x = 10. The fourth line is blue, with star markers and a solid style, starting at approximately 34.8 and exhibiting lot of fluctuation along x-axis, decline to about 34.5 towards the end of the x-axis. A legend is given bottom right.
